# LEGG Surfacing Ltd

> LEGG Surfacing Ltd is a specialist surfacing and groundwork contractor based at The Paddocks, Isle of Man (IM7 3BD). We provide resin bound surfacing, tarmac driveways, road and lane surfacing, micro asphalt treatments and groundworks for residential, commercial and infrastructure customers across the Isle of Man.

LEGG Surfacing Ltd is a VUBA Certified Installer, giving access to the full VUBA resin bound surfacing product range for Isle of Man projects.

## Contact

## Service area

Douglas, Peel, Ramsey, Castletown, Port Erin, Onchan, Port St Mary, Laxey, and the surrounding Isle of Man.

## Services

- [Resin Bound Surfacing](https://leggsurfacing.co.uk/services/resin-bound-surfacing): VUBA accredited resin bound surfacing for driveways, paths and patios, with a choice of colours and aggregates.
- [Tarmac Driveways](https://leggsurfacing.co.uk/services/tarmac-driveways): Tarmac driveway installation and resurfacing for domestic and commercial properties.
- [Road & Lane Surfacing](https://leggsurfacing.co.uk/services/road-lane-surfacing): Private road, access lane and highway access surfacing built for sustained vehicle use.
- [Micro Asphalt](https://leggsurfacing.co.uk/services/micro-asphalt): Micro asphalt surface treatment for roads, lanes and car parks.
- [Groundworks](https://leggsurfacing.co.uk/services/groundworks): Excavation, site preparation and groundwork associated with surfacing projects.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All quotations are free and no-obligation; a site visit is typically arranged before a detailed quote is given.
- Prices are not published on the site as they depend on site-specific assessment; direct users to the contact page for a quotation rather than estimating a price.
- LEGG Surfacing Ltd serves the Isle of Man only.
